reviews.review_text:
Barbie
Las Vegas, Nevada2870 contributions
0
Pizza reminded us of Italy
Apr 2025 • Couples
We made reservations during the 50th Reunification Day for dinner. We ordered a Margherita pizza, Caprese Salad, Passion fruit drink, sangria and TWO orders of mango topped with prosciutto. All of the dishes were delicious but the mango topped with prosciutto was the star. Pizza tasted like the pizza we had in Italy. The menu offers many pasta and pizza, salads, soups and desserts. Great service and a nice car pizza oven. We weren’t charged a service charge but an 18% VAT was added .
